title: Buttery Gooey Indian Egg Noodles Thali
description: A low-fat-friendly, midnight-craving dish inspired by Maharashtrian cuisine, featuring egg noodles, a rich deglazed fond, and a comforting, buttery gooey sauce. Perfect for a late-night snack or a quick breakfast.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and sauté until translucent.
Add the ginger and garlic and sauté for another minute.
Add the flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Gradually add 200ml of water, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the red chili powder, garam masala powder, and salt. Stir well to combine.
Add the butter and stir until melted and well combined.
Add the cooked egg noodles to the sauce and stir to coat.
Simmer for another 2 minutes, until the noodles are well coated in the sauce.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
